# Costco Wholesale Corporation: Business Analysis

## Overview
Costco Wholesale Corporation ("Costco" or the "Company") operates a global retail business [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L9]. The business model generates revenue from "Net sales" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L69] and "Membership fees" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L78]. For the 52-week fiscal year ended August 30, 2026, "Total revenue" reached "303,154" million dollars [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L86], compared to "275,235" million dollars in the prior year [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L87]. In fiscal year 2026, net sales supplied "297,247" million dollars [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L75], while membership fees supplied "5,907" million dollars [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L81]. In the 16-week fourth quarter ended August 30, 2026, total revenue was "95,723" million dollars [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L84], which included "93,873" million dollars in net sales [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L71] and "1,850" million dollars in membership fees [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L79]. Operating expenses for fiscal year 2026 included "264,279" million dollars for "Merchandise costs" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L89-L92] and "27,190" million dollars for "Selling, general and administrative" costs [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L94-L97], which yielded "Operating income" of "11,685" million dollars [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L99-L102]. Full-year "Net income" was "$9.226 billion, $20.76 per diluted share" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L44], up from "$8.099 billion, $18.21 per diluted share, last year" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L44].

## Market Positioning and Growth Outlook
Costco maintains a broad geographic footprint. The Company "currently operates 939 warehouses" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L45]. This footprint includes "647 in the United States and Puerto Rico, 115 in Canada, 43 in Mexico, 37 in Japan, 29 in the United Kingdom, 20 in Korea, 15 in Australia, 14 in Taiwan, seven in China, five in Spain, three in France, two in Sweden, and one each in Iceland, and New Zealand" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L45]. Costco also expands digital market reach because it "operates e-commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Mexico, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, and China" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L45].

Sales growth remains positive across all operating segments:
- In the fourth quarter, "Net sales for the quarter increased 11.2 percent, to $93.9 billion, from $84.4 billion last year" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L10].
- For the fiscal year, "Net sales for the fiscal year increased 10.1 percent, to $297.2 billion, from $269.9 billion last year" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L10].
- Fourth quarter "Total Company" comparable sales increased "9.4%" on an unadjusted basis [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L33-L34] and "6.7%" when "Adjusted*" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L16-L35] to reflect "*Excluding the impacts from changes in gasoline prices and foreign exchange" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L43]. For the full 52 weeks, Total Company comparable sales increased "8.4%" unadjusted [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L36] and "6.6%" adjusted [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L37].
- Regional performance shows broad gains. For the fourth quarter, adjusted comparable sales grew "7.2%" in the "U.S." [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L18-L20], "4.6%" in "Canada" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L23-L25], and "6.2%" in "Other International" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L28-L30]. For the 52-week period, adjusted comparable sales increased "6.6%" in the U.S. [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L22], "6.7%" in Canada [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L27], and "6.5%" in Other International [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L32].
- Growth in "Digitally-Enabled" operations was significant [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L38]. Digitally-enabled comparable sales rose "19.5%" unadjusted [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L39] and "19.8%" adjusted [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L40] during the 16-week period, and rose "20.9%" unadjusted [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L41] and "20.7%" adjusted [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L42] over the 52-week year.

## Future Developments
Financial resources support ongoing capital investment. In fiscal year 2026, Costco generated "15,825" million dollars in "Net cash provided by operating activities" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L305-L306]. The Company directed "(6,435)" million dollars to "Additions to property and equipment" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L309-L310], an increase from "(5,498)" million dollars spent in the prior fiscal year [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L311]. Cash returned to shareholders included "(2,458)" million dollars in "Cash dividend payments" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L343-L344] and "(848)" million dollars in "Repurchases of common stock" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L340-L341]. At year end, Costco held "20,207" million dollars in "Cash and cash equivalents" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L361-L363].

Recent catalysts and operational developments include:
- A specific earnings catalyst occurred in the fourth quarter: "This year's fourth quarter was positively impacted by a non-recurring benefit of $0.15 per diluted share from IEEPA tariff refunds received in the quarter, less partial reinvestment of those refunds in increased member values" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L44].
- The Company identified conditions that may affect future performance in its forward-looking disclosure. Costco states that forward-looking statements address events that the firm "expects or anticipates may occur in the future" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48]. The Company notes that "actual events, results or performance to differ materially" can occur due to risks [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48]. These potential risks include "domestic and international economic conditions, including exchange rates, inflation or deflation" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], "the effects of competition and regulation" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], "consumer and small business spending patterns and debt levels" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], "conditions affecting the acquisition, development, ownership or use of real estate" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], "capital spending" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], "rising costs associated with employees (generally including health-care costs and wages)" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], "energy and certain commodities" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48], and "geopolitical conditions (including tariffs and global conflicts)" [earnings_release_Ex99-1.txt:L48].
